Booking & cancellations

Plan the moment.

Know what is agreed before your shoot or edit begins.

Updated 16 October 2026

Before you book

Share the event date, location, timings and coverage you need. The team confirms creator availability, the package, deliverables, total quote and any advance payment directly. Keep the written confirmation for your records.

Changing a date or cancelling

Contact the team as soon as your plans change. Rescheduling depends on creator availability. Any cancellation charge, refund eligibility, notice period or non-refundable amount must be stated in your written quote before payment; this site does not set a blanket refund percentage.

Extra coverage

Longer shoots, extra hours, travel or additional edits need confirmation before they are added. The final agreed quote explains what is included and what costs extra.

Editing requests

The team confirms the editing scope, price, delivery time and revision allowance before starting. If you want to stop or change an edit after work has started, contact the team to agree the next step and any applicable charge.

Venue access and event changes

Share access restrictions, permissions, venue rules and schedule changes ahead of time. If the event or agreed coverage becomes impossible, contact the team promptly to discuss available alternatives.
